proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hABC hiso hD hang
  have bis : ∀ D : P, Sbtw ℝ B D C → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A D = EuclideanGeometry.angle D A C →
      dist A B / dist A C = dist B D / dist D C := by
    intro D hD hang
    have hDC : D ≠ C := hD.ne_right
    have hAC : A ≠ C := ne₁₃_of_not_collinear hABC
    have hsin : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle D A C) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hABC
      have hcol : Collinear ℝ ({D, A, C} : Set P) :=
        EuclideanGeometry.collinear_iff_eq_or_eq_or_sin_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr h0))
      have hA : A ∈ line[ℝ, D, C] := hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hDC
      have hle : line[ℝ, D, C] ≤ line[ℝ, B, C] :=
        affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem hD.wbtw.mem_affineSpan (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ B C)
      exact collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair (hle hA)
    have l1 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist D A B
    have l2 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist D A C
    have hpi := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi A hD.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
    have hβ : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B D A) = Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle C D A) := by
      rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm B D A, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm C D A,
        show EuclideanGeometry.angle A D B = Real.pi - EuclideanGeometry.angle A D C by linarith, Real.sin_pi_sub]
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm D A B, hang, hβ] at l1
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (dist_ne_zero.mpr hAC) (dist_ne_zero.mpr hDC)]
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hsin
    rw [dist_comm C D] at l2
    linear_combination (dist D C) * l1 - (dist B D) * l2
  have h := bis D hD hang
  have hAC : dist A C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr (ne₁₃_of_not_collinear hABC)
  have hDC : dist D C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hD.ne_right
  rw [hiso, div_self hAC, eq_comm, div_eq_one_iff_eq hDC] at h
  have hs := hD.wbtw.dist_add_dist
  exact eq_midpoint_of_dist_eq_half (by linarith) (by rw [dist_comm B D] at *; linarith [dist_comm C D, dist_comm D B])
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → dist A B = dist A C → Sbtw ℝ B D C → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A D = EuclideanGeometry.angle D A C → D = midpoint ℝ B C
